title: Lupin partner Sandoz launches RanluspecTM across Europe for retinal disease treatment
summary: Lupin Ltd has partnered with Sandoz to launch RanluspecTM, a biosimilar for Ranibizumab, across Europe. This launch will help to improve access to treatments for retinal and choroidal vascular diseases. The European Commission previously approved RanluspecTM...
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
contentHtml:
Pharmaceutical company Lupin Ltd announced on Thursday the launch of RanluspecTM, a biosimilar of the firm’s Ranibizumab, by its commercial partner Sandoz across Europe, excluding Germany.

“The launch of Ranluspec in Europe advances Lupin’s strategy of bringing high-quality biosimilars to more patients suffering from retinal and choroidal vascular diseases. Together with Sandoz, we will expand access to this important treatment across the region,” Thierry Volle, President EMEA and Emerging Markets, Lupin, said.

According to the company’s release, the development follows the European Commission's approval of RanluspecTM in vial and syringe-filled presentations.

Read more: India may open doors to multinational pharma firms for first-in-human Phase I trials

The firm, highlighting the mechanism of action of Ranibizumab, said the drug was developed to treat various types of retinal diseases.

“Ranibizumab is a recombinant humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody fragment that binds and inhibits vascular endothelial growth factor A. The indications of RanluspecTM encompass the treatment of patients with neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration, macular edema following retinal vein occlusion, diabetic macular edema, proliferative diabetic retinopathy, and choroidal neovascularization,” company’s statement said.

Lupin Limited is a multinational pharmaceutical company, operating in over 100 markets. The company specialises in pharmaceutical products, including branded and generic formulations, complex generics,biotechnology products, and active pharmaceutical ingredients.
